strictFilter.name: STRICT v4 (backtest-tested)
strictFilter.note: Backtest: win 42%, avg +0.31R, T1-hit 41%, max DD -16R. Picks na hone par WAIT — weak picks nahi dikhaye jaate.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)
strictTradeFix.note: TRADE STOCKS section ab sirf quality-gated dual-zone stocks dikhata hai: DEMAND + whitelist sector + FRESH zone + 1D/1M score >= 7 + normal volume. Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. Baaki dual-zone stocks WATCH-ONLY (exclReasons ke saath).

courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictFilter.name: STRICT v4 (backtest-tested)
strictFilter.note: Backtest: win 42%, avg +0.31R, T1-hit 41%, max DD -16R. Picks na hone par WAIT — weak picks nahi dikhaye jaate.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)
strictTradeFix.note: TRADE STOCKS section ab sirf quality-gated dual-zone stocks dikhata hai: DEMAND + whitelist sector + FRESH zone + 1D/1M score >= 7 + normal volume. Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. Baaki dual-zone stocks WATCH-ONLY (exclReasons ke saath).

courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictFilter.name: STRICT v4 (backtest-tested)
strictFilter.note: Backtest: win 42%, avg +0.31R, T1-hit 41%, max DD -16R. Picks na hone par WAIT — weak picks nahi dikhaye jaate.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)
strictTradeFix.note: TRADE STOCKS section ab sirf quality-gated dual-zone stocks dikhata hai: DEMAND + whitelist sector + FRESH zone + 1D/1M score >= 7 + normal volume. Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. Baaki dual-zone stocks WATCH-ONLY (exclReasons ke saath).

courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)
strictTradeFix.note: TRADE STOCKS section ab sirf quality-gated dual-zone stocks dikhata hai: DEMAND + whitelist sector + FRESH zone + 1D/1M score >= 7 + normal volume. Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)
strictTradeFix.note: TRADE STOCKS section ab sirf quality-gated dual-zone stocks dikhata hai: DEMAND + whitelist sector + FRESH zone + 1D/1M score >= 7 + normal volume. Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)

Backtest (May-Aug 2026, 102 dual-zone demand signals): RAW win 41% avg +0.36R PF 1.62 DD -8.0R SL 59% -> STRICT win 50% avg +0.50R PF 2.0 DD -3.0R SL 50%. courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.

strictTradeFix.name: STRICT TRADE v5.1 (dual-zone negative-edge fix)

courseMode.note: GTF course Ep 5/6/8 vetoes (data-validated): >5 base = garbage, course trade score < 5.5 = weak. Backtest: avgR +0.32R -> +0.61R, win 42% -> 50%. Signals kam, quality zyada.
